assets.title: Simulated lighter-object mass inference with O4-design detector sensitivity

assets.credit: Noah E. Wolfe, Salvatore Vitale and Colm Talbot (2023), Too small to fail: characterizing sub-solar mass black hole mergers with gravitational waves, Figure 2, arXiv:2305.19907v2, CC BY 4.0. Original PDF rendered to PNG; scientific content unchanged.
assets.caption: Forecast posterior distributions for the lighter object source-frame mass in simulated signals at O4-design LIGO-Hanford, LIGO-Livingston and Virgo sensitivity. Left: non-precessing; right: precessing. Color shows network signal-to-noise ratio and line style shows the heavier object spin. These are simulated examples, not observed detections.
assets.caution: The curves are not normalized in this presentation; do not interpret their plotted heights as comparable probabilities. Preserve all labels and the full figure.
